description: This file defines the interface for a PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) processor in a 5G NR simulation or implementation, including configuration structures, a notifier interface, and validation interface.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifications upon completion of PDSCH processing.

classes.name: pdsch_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing PDSCH transmissions, including configuration and processing methods.

classes.name: pdsch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating PDSCH processing configuration parameters.

methods.name: on_finish_processing
methods.description: Callback invoked when PDSCH processing is finished.

methods.name: ~pdsch_processor
methods.description: Destructor for the PDSCH processor interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a PDSCH transmission with given resource grid, notifier, data, and parameters.

methods.name: ~pdsch_pdu_validator
methods.description: Destructor for the PDSCH PDU validator interface.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the PDSCH processing parameters, returning success or error message.
